mission_05: Great work! You have successfully applied SelectKBest with ANOVA F-test for feature selection. You learned how to score features using f_classif, interpret F-scores and p-values, and select the top K features. SelectKBest is a powerful univariate selection method that identifies features with the strongest individual relationship to the target. The p-values tell you whether the relationship is statistically significant. For classification, use f_classif; for regression, use f_regression. Combine SelectKBest with cross-validation to find the optimal K value for your specific problem.
